## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger, resulting behavior and scope. Link an existing
issue when relevant; a new issue is not required merely for a local change.

## Verification

List actual commands/results, failed attempts, limits and unrun checks. Use
[contribution policy](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[verification ownership](../docs/agents/testing.md) for the affected lanes.

- [ ] Formatting, lint and relevant current docs/CI checks pass.
- [ ] Owning behavioral/negative controls and affected package links pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects setup, API, safety or scope changes.
- [ ] Unrelated work, source boundaries, pins and notices remain protected.

Independent acceptance, when required, uses a separate reviewer. Local packing
does not authorize publication, push, deployment or reference-source changes.
